decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (  ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the outbuilding hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be used other than for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the dwelling house at 114 Vicarage Farm Road and shall not be occupied as primary living accommodation, a separate dwelling or for business purposes.
description: Erection of a single storey detached outbuilding at rear of garden following demolition of existing garage for use as a gym/store.
